# CliprAuto

> CliprAuto is a done-for-you video clipping service. It turns long-form video (podcasts, interviews, webinars, talks) into finished short clips with captions for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, TikTok, LinkedIn and other platforms. Clips are checked by software before delivery. A free sample made from the customer's own recording comes first.

The clipping service is not a software download. No guarantee of views. Paid monthly by card, PayPal or invoice (USD): Starter $500, Growth $1,099, Premium $1,499.

## Main pages
- [Home and plans](https://cliprauto.com/): what we do, how we test every clip, plans and the free sample form
- [Podcast clipping service](https://cliprauto.com/podcasts/): clips from podcast episodes
- [YouTube creators](https://cliprauto.com/youtube-creators/): Shorts, Reels and TikToks from long YouTube videos
- [Experts and companies](https://cliprauto.com/experts-and-companies/): LinkedIn, Reels and Shorts from webinars, interviews and talks
- [CliprAuto, the software](https://cliprauto.com/cliprauto/): software that runs TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts accounts on the customer's own computer. One-time purchase for Mac or Windows: Minimum $247, Creator $347, Studio $447
- [Clipr Website](https://cliprauto.com/website/): free automatic website review (Beta): a private report on what to fix first
- [CliprAuto in short](https://cliprauto.com/about/): facts, inputs, outputs, formats, pricing and what we do not do

- [Video sizes for Reels, Shorts, TikTok and LinkedIn](https://cliprauto.com/guides/video-sizes-reels-shorts-tiktok-linkedin/): The four formats that cover every platform, and what each is for.
- [How to choose which moments of a podcast to clip](https://cliprauto.com/guides/choose-podcast-moments-to-clip/): A checklist, and the red flags that tell you to skip a moment.
